title: LA DeepBlack 092 Solo – Zellige Star
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing, deepest ebony skin with cool blue-black undertones, late 20s, hourglass queen physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — impossibly cinched waist, hips flaring beyond human proportion, enormous full bust, thick touching thighs, long sleek hair with a gold chain headpiece — full body Moroccan zellige star body art from neck to ankle, EVERY inch covered, NO bare skin below neck. Bold black outlines — EMERALD, COBALT, and SAFFRON eight-point star tessellations across torso and both legs to ankle, WHITE interlace bands, filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: three-quarter front, one hand lifting her hair at shoulder height, other hand on hip, chest and belly fully visible.
Footwear: emerald cobalt peep-toe platform stilettos with crossed ankle straps 8 inch. Nails: extra long coffin nails, emerald with gold star.
Extreme high-gloss oil. MANDATORY pure pitch black background only, NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. CRITICAL: legs show FULL BODY ART coverage hip to ankle to toe. Zellige star art must BLAZE against the deepest ebony skin. Emphasis on the extreme body volume. 8K portrait 2:3 vertical.
